scope: Bounded ND IO descriptor adaptation in diagnostic probe and formal executor; no graph or numerical tolerance changes
acceptance_rule: Require ND, then exact shape or existing rank1..3 trailing ones to rank4, or new rank3 [a,b,c] to rank4 [1,a,b,c] with every original dimension unchanged.
byte_contract: Allocate using the actual runtime descriptor, retain logical dtype and byte count. No data permutation, global squeeze or equal-numel-only acceptance.

host_validation.backend: fake HIAI; byte transport only, not NPU arithmetic
coverage: Board-reported rank3 shapes for both input and output; FP16/FP32/INT32 and runtime descriptor identity
Reject middle padding, permutations, non-singleton leading dimensions, same-numel reshapes, rank5 and non-ND before Process
Allocation and buffer-length failures remain enforced
Target leading-one feature output to exact or trailing-one draft feature layout, full byte transfer endpoints and generated tokens preserved
Rank2 token leading-one remains rejected; sequence and draft width retain ABI positions

independent_review.scope: Read-only review of both C++ policies and new probe/formal tests
findings: Identical bounded rank3 leading-one rules with ND gate and actual descriptor allocation
Logical byte count and rank2 token axis handling preserved
Mixed target/draft feature layout tests assert initialization descriptors and transferred endpoint bytes
Positive/negative layout and buffer coverage sufficient

limitations: GetModelIOTensorDim does not expose actual dtype; declared dtype remains artifact-bound
Host fake tests do not establish numerical agreement, runtime placement or successful board Process
Only the independent probe is rebuilt by the next command; existing formal runner binary is unchanged
